title: Fractional CTO using AI to integrate and build (Invite-Only)
description:
We are a regulated B2B SaaS platform for service-based businesses. It covers staff onboarding, e-signatures, training, client intake, scheduling and time verification, billing, and compliance tracking. We're in production on AWS with customers onboarding now. Much of our development is done by AI coding agents under a defined process. We need an experienced technical leader to oversee architecture, security and releases, and to be our accountable human engineering lead.

What you'll do (about 5–10 hours a week to start, flexible)
- Review and approve architecture, pull requests and releases, and set engineering standards and guardrails for AI-assisted development.
- Own security and data-protection safeguards: access control, encryption, audit logging, incident response, backup and restore testing, and vendor security and data processing agreements.
- Lead SOC 2 readiness: choose a compliance platform and auditor, and coordinate a third-party penetration test.
- Oversee AWS infrastructure in Terraform (ECS Fargate, CloudFront and WAF, DocumentDB, S3, Secrets Manager, KMS, Bedrock) and approve infrastructure changes.
- Guide third-party integrations: billing and payment processors, government or industry data exchanges, external reporting systems, and partner onboarding.
- Own monitoring, on-call escalation and uptime. Join a monthly roadmap review with the founder.

Must have
- 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ in a CTO, VP Engineering or principal role.
- Hands-on experience running a production system that handles sensitive or regulated data (privacy compliance, data processing agreements, audits).
- AWS production experience; Terraform.
- Python (FastAPI or similar) and React; MongoDB or DocumentDB.
- Experience leading a SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 or similar certification effort.

Strong plus
- Experience with EDI or other standardized B2B data exchange formats and clearinghouse-style integrations.
- Experience integrating with government or state-run systems.
- Overseeing AI-assisted or agent-based development workflows.
- Mobile (React Native / Expo).

How we work
- Remote based. You'll sign an NDA and a data protection agreement before access.
- Least-privilege access; no customer data outside our systems.
- Start with a paid 2-week assessment: an architecture and security review with a prioritized plan. Then ongoing monthly.
